title: When Looks Make You Click "Submit": Participation-Mediated Appearance Bias in Teaching Evaluations

contributions.purpose: 量化颜值溢价中经由评教参与率的中介份额
contributions.mechanism: 三方程中介模型(beauty→participation→score),教授聚类稳健 SE + cluster bootstrap
contributions.domain: 教学评价公平性/应用计量
contributions.source_quote: About 17% of this premium is statistically mediated by higher student participation (95% CI: [0.0008, 0.0354]).

contributions.purpose: 揭示偏见来自'谁去评'而非仅'怎么评'
contributions.mechanism: 调节中介:按班级规模、母语英语分层
contributions.source_quote: a surprising source of bias is who chooses to rate, not just how students rate

contributions.purpose: 提供可复现评教政策分析模板
contributions.mechanism: 公开数据 + 分数逻辑中介 + 稳健性/占位符检验的脚本管线
contributions.evaluation: UT Austin 数据 463 课/94 教授;稳健性 4 设定 15–18% 一致
contributions.source_quote: we provide a reproducible pipeline and reporting template for evaluation policy.

notes: 非实证类适配问题:纯观测研究、明确非因果(反复自限 'associations, not causal';需 sequential ignorability),定性/描述性,evaluation 用系数与 CI 而非精度数字。统计弱点(负结果):中介份额 0.169 的 95%CI[-0.010,0.401] 跨零;非母语子群 CI 极宽[-0.103,0.267]。数据红旗:Reproducibility 自述仅 150 次 bootstrap('recommend ≥1000 for camera-ready')且提供 'table shells',属草稿态。checklist 四项全 [D](假设/设计/分析/写作均 LLM 生成)。公开 UT Austin(Hamermesh)数据集。desk-reject。
